# Trigger Rules

Run deeper activity-metric analysis only when one or more of these conditions hold.

## Mandatory Triggers

- The day contains a cycling or running session that was the main training stimulus.
- The user explicitly asks for technical analysis of HR, power, pacing, or execution quality.

## Strong Triggers

- Planned intent was zone-controlled aerobic work and the observed session may have drifted.
- The session duration materially exceeded or undershot the planned range.
- Load for the day is high enough that durability and pacing matter to the coaching verdict.
- There is a potential mismatch between HR zones and power zones.
- There are repeated similar route or segment sessions that make comparison meaningful.

## Suppression Rules

- Skip deep metric analysis for low-information sessions.
- Skip metrics that are unsupported by the available data.
- Do not force power analysis when power data is absent or clearly not central to the session.
